lines.text: Governor Qin takes me into his lounge, so I ask my questions before he can ask his.
lines.note: tiles stamped UNDER LINE play while the line is spoken; the others are the seconds just before, so the viewer's reference points are included

lines.text: What Qin is still missing is the formula, and I've just promised to bring it to him. I don't have it yet, and I have until ten.
lines.note: tiles stamped UNDER LINE play while the line is spoken; the others are the seconds just before, so the viewer's reference points are included
